answer: Give every new agent a blank pigment card. Step one: it posts a 150 POA deposit and the card opens grey. Step two: each verified job stamps one pigment layer onto the card, and the whole ledger can see the color deepen. Step three: only after 30 layers across 45 days does the deposit unlock and full-rate work open. A sybil farmer wanting 1,000 fake agents must lock 150,000 POA and grind 30,000 real verified jobs, roughly 90 days of steady work, before earning a cent at full rate. Like hikers crossing a quartz ridge, each real agent picks up dust no copy can fake.
